AnchorSuggestion.description: A name the anchor field can offer (``GET /api/anchors/search``).
AnchorSuggestion.title: AnchorSuggestion

AnnotationRecord.description:
An annotation as the stage reads it: the W3C Web Annotation, who wrote it, and whether the reader may remove
it (its author, or a curator).
AnnotationRecord.title: AnnotationRecord

CaseImageRecord.description: An image of a contributor's case: its state, and its file's (the last upload).
CaseImageRecord.title: CaseImageRecord

CaseRecord.description: A contributor's case to reopen (``GET /api/slide-cases/{id}``): its summary and the case as last sent.
CaseRecord.title: CaseRecord

CaseSummary.description: A contributor's slide case in their list (``GET /api/slide-cases``).
CaseSummary.title: CaseSummary

CollectionNodeDetail.description: One node (``GET /api/collections/{id}``): itself with its children, and the path down to it.
CollectionNodeDetail.title: CollectionNodeDetail

CollectionNodeRecord.description: A node of the collection tree (``GET /api/collections``), with its published slides counted.
CollectionNodeRecord.title: CollectionNodeRecord

CollectionTreeRecord.description: The whole tree: the three realms and everything under them.
CollectionTreeRecord.title: CollectionTreeRecord

CommunityRecord.description: How the identifications agree (R-088): the node, its anchor when Laminario can name it, and every score.
CommunityRecord.title: CommunityRecord

CreatedSlideCase.description: The answer of ``POST /api/slide-cases``: the new draft and the flags of its submission.
CreatedSlideCase.title: CreatedSlideCase

DefinitionRecord.description: One condition of a node's rule, for people: a taxon with its GBIF page, a rock family, a part.
DefinitionRecord.title: DefinitionRecord

FacetCounts.description:
For each facet, its values under the current filters and how many slides each would match (the facet's own
filter left out, so a second value shows what it adds).
FacetCounts.title: FacetCounts

FacetRecord.description: A property that cuts across the tree, with the icon of each value.
FacetRecord.title: FacetRecord

FlagRecord.description: A flag as the curators see it (``GET /api/flags``).
FlagRecord.title: FlagRecord

IdentificationRecord.description: An identification on a slide, as a viewer may see it (``GET /api/slides/{id}/identifications``).
IdentificationRecord.title: IdentificationRecord

InvitationRecord.description:
An invitation as its issuer sees it. ``link`` is present only in the answer that created it, and only
when it was not mailed: the token is never stored, so it cannot be shown again.
InvitationRecord.title: InvitationRecord

JobEventRecord.description: One Server-Sent Event of a job's stream: its ``id`` field is ``seq``, its ``event`` field ``event``.
JobEventRecord.title: JobEventRecord

JobRecord.description: A processing job as ``GET /api/jobs/{id}`` returns it.
JobRecord.title: JobRecord

MapPointRecord.description: A slide on the map, after geoprivacy: an obscured one at its public point, with its 0.2 degree cell.
MapPointRecord.title: MapPointRecord

ModerationActionRecord.description: A curator's hiding or restoring, with the reason.
ModerationActionRecord.title: ModerationActionRecord

PartRecord.description: A part of an organism the part field offers (``GET /api/vocab/parts``), with its organ system.
PartRecord.title: PartRecord

PlaceRecord.description: Where the specimen was collected, after geoprivacy.
PlaceRecord.title: PlaceRecord

PlacementResult.description: Where a slide belongs (``POST /api/placement``): the suggestion, and every node that accepts it.
PlacementResult.title: PlacementResult

SlideSummary.description: A slide in a list: enough to draw it in a drawer.
SlideSummary.title: SlideSummary

SummaryLabel.description: What a drawer shows on a slide's label end (no coordinates, so nothing geoprivacy withholds).
SummaryLabel.title: SummaryLabel

UploadRecord.description: An upload as its contributor sees it (``GET /api/uploads``).
UploadRecord.title: UploadRecord

ValidationError.description:
A reason a slide case is refused: the field, the API's message and what would be accepted, and a stable code
with the values the message names, so an interface can say it in its own words (R-1202).
ValidationError.title: ValidationError
